# FluxDesk

> The AI workspace that flows with your work. One desk, every tool, unlimited growth.

FluxDesk is a SaaS prompt engineering and AI workflow platform for knowledge workers, developers, and teams. It lets users create, organise, test, run, and share prompts and multi-step AI pipelines across leading large language model providers.

## Core Features

- **Prompt Library**: Create, tag, and search reusable prompt templates across projects
- **AI Pipeline Builder**: Chain multiple AI tools into automated multi-step workflows
- **20+ AI Tools**: Pre-built tools including PromptForge, Code Review Brief, Bug→Task, Commit Writer, Feature Spec, ADR Generator, Tech Stack Advisor, Standup Writer, Flashcard Factory, Model Comparator, Meeting Mirror, Stakeholder Translator, Decision Autopsy, and more
- **Multi-model Support**: Works with OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Groq — bring your own API key
- **Shareable Pipelines**: Share pipelines publicly via a unique URL
- **Insights**: Usage analytics and productivity insights
- **Demo Mode**: Try FluxDesk without an account

## Use Cases

- Prompt engineering and iteration
- AI-assisted code review and commit message generation
- Automated specification and documentation writing
- Team knowledge management with AI
- Multi-step AI content workflows

## Audience

Knowledge workers, software engineers, product managers, technical writers, and teams that use AI tools daily.

## Pricing

Free plan available. No credit card required to sign up.
